assertions.name: binds admitted package configurations as configuration members without changing source inventory
denies unadmitted changed-source changed-inventory and changed-byte package configurations
requires explicit package config admission and binds captured configs without expanding source inventory
keeps binary files with semantic extensions out of text evidence
binds every nonexcluded source byte independently of semantic parse coverage
records Git, dependency, runtime and credential exclusions without opening their content
never treats truncated source coverage as a reviewable lexical warning
finds frontend, real server routes, data/auth dependencies and migrations across a monorepo
consumes resolved source modules and configuration as cross-service dependency evidence
never promotes a dynamic module or declared external package into resolved local completeness
connects explicit local dependency targets without linking a same-name workspace fixture
retains graph diagnostic loss state with 512 lexical source files
retains graph diagnostic loss state with 513 lexical source files
assigns one-character service roots and deeper children before the whole-root fallback
decodes a UTF-8 BOM tolerantly while binding and comparing the raw bytes (SA-3)
reports an import of an excluded generated-output or credential input as an explicit issue (SVC-8)
aggregates connection evidence rows per service, module key and kind (SA-2)
retains a native reference Dockerfile as configuration without treating it as unsupported executable source
